title: Microsoft Teams: Share reactions at events with up to 100,000 attendees
description: Stay more engaged and connected with the audience, even at events with up to 100,000 attendees. Teams now supports reactions in events at this scale. You can send reactions during the event and see the reactions others send, so everyone can share the moment together.
